newsitem.title: POLAND: Poland, Latvia come to terms on pre-1939 treaties.
newsitem.headline: Poland, Latvia come to terms on pre-1939 treaties.

text.p: Foreign ministers of Poland and Latvia on Monday signed an agreement concerning 16 bilateral treaties going back to before World War Two, PAP news agency said.
It said that two treaties dealing with cooperation in the commercial-maritime field and in the area of social security would remain in force until new agreements were reached.
The remaining 14 were declared null and void by virtue of having expired.
The agreement was signed by Polish Foreign Minister Dariusz Rosati and his Latvian opposite number, Valdis Birkavs.
Following the signing ceremony, Birkavs told reporters the two countries would work closer together in their drive towards membership of the European Union and NATO.
